text: BORA is the brand of Bora Lüftungstechnik GmbH of Raubling, Upper Bavaria, a private German company founded in 2007 by Willi Bruckbauer, who remains its CEO.
short: BORA is the brand of Bora Lüftungstechnik GmbH, founded by Willi Bruckbauer, who remains CEO.

source.name: kbb Focus — Bora CEO Willi Bruckbauer on the power of being a niche brand
source.quote: Bora Lüftungstechnik GmbH was founded in 2007 in Raubling, Upper Bavaria, by Willi Bruckbauer, 53, who remains the CEO.
